description: Plain decode with the installed-RAM tier cap forced back to a fifth (CAMELID_GEMMA4_GHOST_HOST_TIER_MAX_MIB=3224) -- the behaviour before the cap became regime-dependent. The control for the capacity-cliff change: the tier is a victim cache for the VRAM arena, re-fetches arrive ~990 intervening misses after eviction, and a fifth sizes it at 974 records, stranded just under the reuse distance it exists to span. If this arm ever wins, the quarter is too big.
